metadata.description: Ujayanta Palace belongs to the royals of indigenous community in Tripura. Pradyot Kishor Manikya Deb Burma is the head of the royal family at present. He is also playing a very important role in the politics of Tripura. TIPRA MOTHA - a party formed by him has gained a strong base in the state with in one year of it's formation. We met him at his royal palace in Agartala and discussed the future plan of his political outfit.
